Allows you to move about undetected by monsters and animals.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== By drinking Sneaky Elixirs, [[Link]] can receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. They are capable of calming his nerves and silencing his footfalls, which allows him to be able to move undetected amongst [[Monster]]s and [[Creature]]s. Sneaky Elixirs come in three varying levels of efficiency.{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Elixir}}
Grants a mid-level stealth effect, which calms the nerves and silences footfalls. Allows you to move about undetected by monsters and animals.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Elixir}}
Grants a high-level stealth effect, which calms the nerves and silences footfalls. Allows you to move about undetected by monsters and animals.|Inventory|BotW}} They can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Sunset Firefly]] By adding any of these sneaky ingredients, Link can make a Sneaky Elixir that will also replenish his [[Heart]]s: * [[Blue Nightshade]] * [[Silent Princess]] * [[Silent Shroom]] * [[Sneaky River Snail]] * [[Stealthfin Trout]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Sneaky Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]] or [[Portable Pot]]: * [[Sunset Firefly]] By adding any of these sneaky ingredients, Link can make a Sneaky Elixir that will also replenish his [[Heart]]s: * [[Blue Nightshade]] * [[Silent Princess]] * [[Silent Shroom]] * [[Sneaky River Snail]] * [[Stealthfin Trout]] ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
